purpose: A centred display-h2 that labels the group below it.
maxWordsBasis: longest real heading across the four T-DETAIL sequences, T-COMPARISON and T-PILLAR
geometry: frame w-[70.3em]; 71.03px for one line, 142.06 for two

constraints.maxPerPageBasis: T-DETAIL-VALUES emits up to 8 headings; T-COMPARISON emits 9; T-PILLAR emits 12 counting its reading-list h3 labels. 12 is the real ceiling.

criticalRule: line-height 1.48. DIFFERENT ROLE from .marketing-rich-text h2 (1.2). DO NOT UNIFY THEM.
